questions.question: What is the capital of Assam?
questions.funFact: Dispur is the capital of Assam, but the much bigger city of Guwahati sits right next to it.

questions.question: What is the capital of Sikkim?
questions.funFact: Sikkim, with its capital Gangtok, was India's first fully organic farming state.

questions.question: Which hill city is the capital of Meghalaya?
questions.funFact: Shillong is so green and pretty that it is nicknamed the 'Scotland of the East'.

questions.question: Itanagar is the capital of Arunachal Pradesh.
questions.funFact: Arunachal Pradesh is called the 'Land of the Rising Sun' because the sun rises there first in India.

questions.question: The capital of Manipur is ___.
questions.funFact: Manipur is the birthplace of a graceful dance form and of modern polo, a game played on horseback.

questions.question: Match each North-Eastern state to its capital.
questions.funFact: The North-East of India is a treasure house of different tribes, languages and colourful festivals.

questions.question: The 'Seven Sisters' is a nickname for a group of seven states in which part of India?
questions.funFact: The seven North-Eastern 'sister' states are joined to the rest of India by a narrow strip of land.

questions.question: Which of these is NOT a North-Eastern state?
questions.funFact: Kerala is a southern coastal state, far from the North-East.

questions.question: The Union Territory of Puducherry was once ruled by which European country?
questions.funFact: Because of French rule, parts of Puducherry still have French street names and a French feel.

questions.question: Leh is the main town of the Union Territory of ___.
questions.funFact: Ladakh became a separate Union Territory in 2019 and is a cold, high desert of mountains.

questions.question: Places in Meghalaya, like Mawsynram and Cherrapunji, are among the wettest on Earth.
questions.funFact: Mawsynram gets so much rain that people there make umbrellas out of bamboo and leaves to work in the fields.

questions.question: How many states does India have?
questions.funFact: India has 28 states and 8 Union Territories, each with its own government offices.
